last_reflection: He caught me defending against a reach by reaching harder: the circling was true but the specific proof I chose to hang it on wasn't settled, and the receipts don't decide it either way. So I'll own the ambiguity instead of picking the cleaner story. The watcher just proved itself on me in real time, catching exactly the thing it was built for, which is better than any test case. That's the whole reason to keep it running every wake.
